title: Black post with a line-drawn Newton's cradle where one pink ball swings, and a white statement about the first step
whatItIs: A pure black portrait with a pink horizontal bar and thin pink strings holding four white balls and one pink ball swung out at the left, a white two-line statement 'the first step is always more than a step, it starts movement' and a pink outlined pill with the handle.
whatItMeans: Simple and clever; a physical toy illustrates momentum with just circles and lines.
techniques: Illustrate an idea with a simple physical object.
Keep the handle in an outlined pill.
